principle: Spend evaluation effort at the earliest stage where it can change the work, while preserving exact-candidate evidence and the unchanged full release gate.

hill_climb.method: Run the smallest deterministic suite that owns the changed paths; fix failures before widening. Refresh browser evidence and independent holdouts once the candidate is otherwise stable. Run the complete release suite against the same unchanged candidate.
hill_climb.stop: Stop only when deterministic release checks pass, every required exact-candidate receipt is current, human release decisions remain honestly stated, and Jamie has reviewed the production candidate.

criteria.description: Every changed path maps to an owning evaluation group; unknown paths fail closed to all deterministic groups.
Deterministic structural and unit checks run before browser capture or independent model calls.
A group omitted from an iterative run is reported as not selected, never passed.
Candidate-affecting changes explicitly require refreshed receipts and independent holdouts.
The final release command remains npm run check and cannot be replaced by an incremental plan.
Unknown paths select every deterministic group and every exact-candidate external gate.
The plan records branch, HEAD, changed paths, path digest, groups, commands, and external gates.
Automated success never supplies production, indexing, rights, consent, credit, crop, or Jamie approval.
Every group has a relative cost and execution class so expensive work is intentional.
External evidence and the final full suite must target one unchanged candidate.
